title: TOEIC® Listening - Versión 3: Human Resources & Talent Acquisition
description: Prueba intensiva de comprensión auditiva TOEIC® enfocada en el contexto de Nexus Industries con the HR Director.

parts.visual:
## 📸 Simulación de Auditiva: Nexus Industries

Evaluaremos tu destreza auditiva en el contexto de **Nexus Industries** (Líder a cargo: **the HR Director**).

Concéntrate plenamente en las descripciones y los audios corporativos.
parts.audio: Welcome to this specialized TOEIC Listening drill. Listen closely to the speaker options and pick the best description of the workspace. Good luck!

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTOGRAPH]: Look at the business picture of Nexus Industries's office staff. Select the correct description.
questions.audio_script: A) They are interviewing a job applicant. B) The HR offices are being painted. C) They are printing employee contracts. D) They are leaving the training hall.
questions.explanation: La descripción B es errónea; la A es correcta porque representa una entrevista formal de selección.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the conversation and answer: What is the main issue discussed by the speakers?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi Jessica, did you see the new HR guidelines from Nexus Industries?
W: Yes, they focus on payroll integration and onboarding. The HR Director sent the draft.
M: I will email the HR team to schedule our onboarding walkthrough.
options: The contract pricing is too high.
The delivery window is too narrow for their schedule.
They want to cancel the shipment.
The company wants to buy ApexCRM.
questions.correct_answer: The delivery window is too narrow for their schedule.
questions.explanation: La mujer menciona explícitamente: 'pricing is competitive, but their delivery window is too narrow for our schedule'.
